The '''Carrion sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It was part of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].
